channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: OpenAI closes $11B first close at $1.25T valuation — weekly financing recap
item.description: OpenAI took in about $11 billion in a first funding close at a $1.25 trillion valuation, with the full round still to come.

item.title: Weekly funding roundup: Applied Compute $350M, Larridin $30M, Firmly.ai $15M, Cowboy $5M
item.description: Applied Compute raised $350M for custom enterprise AI models, and Larridin, Firmly.ai and Cowboy closed rounds in the same week.

item.title: Stablecoin payments jumped 45% to $482B while supply barely grew; agent payments doubled to 68.3M in Q3 but totaled just $3.7M
item.description: Stablecoin payments jumped 45% to $482B this year while supply barely grew — and AI agent payments doubled to 68 million in Q3, worth just $3.7M total.

item.title: OpenAI ships GPT-6 Cyber and Images 2.6, moves to acquire Pierre; Anthropic ships message threads and open-sources FlashProve
item.description: OpenAI launched a cybersecurity model and new image tools and is buying Pierre for coding-agent Git workflows; Anthropic added message threads and open-sourced FlashProve.
